system.description: When you use False Face targeting a non-ally, raise its total MP cost by up to (SL x 10) to spawn one additional illusion per 10 MP. An enemy attacking may make a (WLP + INS) Opposed Check against you; on success it picks one identical target at random, otherwise it hits and destroys an illusion for no damage.
